CustomEmailTemplate.description: Hard bounce and suppression notice. Sent because the address is undeliverable, not because the person asked. Keeping these two cases separate is what stops a deliverability problem from destroying a consented audience.

emailTemplate.name: Address_Undeliverable_Notice
emailTemplate.subject: We could not deliver your message

CustomEmailTemplate.label: Address Undeliverable Notice
CustomEmailTemplate.name: Address_Undeliverable_Notice

div.p: We were unable to deliver a message to this address. You have been removed from marketing sends as a result.
This is a delivery issue, not a change to your marketing preferences. If you would like to hear from us, you can update your address or re-subscribe at your preference centre.
Messages about an existing transaction are unaffected.
